verdict.rationale: A government IP-office portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant or chatbot, so this axis applies. The evidence covers only e-filing, search, status tracking, cause lists and fee schedules, and the llms.txt probe returned 404. Nothing in the pack shows any built-in AI assistant to which tasks can be delegated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
